remarks: Tucked away in a peaceful natural setting, this charming cottage offers the rare combination of privacy, comfort, and convenience - just a short drive from all that Stamford has to offer. Inside, you'll find a warm and inviting living area, a comfortable bedroom, and a full bath. The fully equipped kitchen is ready for home-cooked meals, and the layout makes the most of every square foot, including your own washer and dryer. Ideal for single occupancy. Step outside to your private carport, no snow shoveling required! All utilities included. The only additional expense a tenant would have is their own cable television and/or internet service - making budgeting simple and straightforward. Strong credit history required. No pets, please.
